name: LinkedIn
description: LinkedIn is a professional networking platform that allows users to connect with colleagues, discover job opportunities, and share industry insights.

events.d: Publish a post with text and an image to your profile.

events.n: When a new post is published on a company page
events.d: Runs the workflow automatically when a new post is published on a company page you follow.
Retrieve a company page’s profile (name, website, description, logo, locations, etc.) and optionally its follower counts. Provide the company page ID or URN.

events.n: Create Link Post on Company Page
events.d: Publish a link or article preview to a LinkedIn company page with optional title, description, and visibility settings.

events.n: Create Video Post on Company Page
events.d: Create and publish a video post on a LinkedIn company page, with optional thumbnail and captions.
Post a reaction (Like, Celebrate, Support, etc.) to a LinkedIn post from a company page.
Creates a like on a LinkedIn comment.
Get an all existing comments on company page.
Get posts from a company page.
Post a comment as the company on a company page post. Optionally include an image.
Retrieve a member's profile and basic details (name, headline, email, profile picture).
Post a reply to a comment on an authenticated user's post as the specified Company Page.
Remove a comment or reply from a company post.
Get an all existing comments on users post.

events.n: List Comment Replies on Company Post
events.d: Retrieve replies for a specific comment.

events.n: Create Image Post on Company Page
events.d: Post an image with caption, optional alt text, and visibility settings to a company page.

events.n: When a new comment is added to a post on a company page
events.d: Runs the workflow automatically when a new comment is added to a post on the selected company page.
Publish a text, article/link, image, or video post to your LinkedIn profile timeline.
Get engagement and performance metrics for posts on a company page.
Retrieve follower statistics for a company page, either demographic breakdowns (country, seniority, industry) or time-range reports.
Get follower, impression, and engagement metrics for a LinkedIn Page or Brand, with optional date range and granularity.

events.n: Get Company Follower Growth Over Date Range
events.d: Retrieve follower growth for a company page across a selected date range and time granularity.

events.n: Get Share Statistics Over Date Range
events.d: Get a company page's share metrics (impressions, unique impressions, clicks, likes, comments, shares, engagement) for a specified date range, optionally grouped by day, week, or month.
Delete a post from a company page using its full LinkedIn URN (e.g., urn:li:share:123).
Retrieve the current LinkedIn member's profile. Returns all fields or limit to selected fields.
